note: The main banks were taken as Malta's three largest by assets, a choice from general knowledge (no central bank or association ranking was read in this pass): Bank of Valletta, HSBC Malta and APS Bank. HSBC Malta: its credit card comparison pages, read 2026-10-30. The Visa and Mastercard credit cards each cost 21 euros a year and bear a variable 8.25% a year, 5.75 points over the bank's base rate (15.10% APR in the representative example), with up to 56 days without interest. The Advance and Premier credit cards, with no annual fee, are open only to holders whose salary of a stated size, savings or mortgage is with HSBC Malta, which the game doesn't check, so they aren't written. The pages state no cash, foreign-currency or late terms. Bank of Valletta's pages answered with a bot check; APS Bank wasn't reached in this pass. In wave 4 (2026-10-30) APS Bank's site answered with an Incapsula check and wasn't read; Bank of Valletta's had a bot check in wave 3; no bank was added. HSBC Malta's Card Conditions of Use (read 2026-10-30): the minimum payment is the greater of 12 euros or 5% of the outstanding balance on the statement (the whole balance below 12 euros), written as 5% with a 12-euro floor on both cards; any excess over the limit and arrears, due on top, aren't modelled.
